interpretation: No training on these donors occurs in this experiment. Inherited backbone/checkpoint data exposure remains subject to audit; do not claim a proven unseen-donor evaluation.
The public labels are model assisted, not independent transcription.
Fine-derived7.9um tensors do not replicate native7.9um scanner appearance.
Small fixed cores may contain no class contrast or no complete letter.
Results do not rescue or change the separate Hecate native-resolution gates.
No promotion rule or target acquisition is built in.

limits.resource_semantics: Soft forward/RSS guards checked between forwards; completed outputs preserved before a stop. Whole-run alarm can be deferred by native operations and blocking HTTP calls. Application-body bytes are counted; wire bytes not measured.

model_execution.forwards: Exactly PHerc0841/source,PHerc0841/reverse,PHerc0814/source,PHerc0814/reverse, unless a declared resource/source failure stops the run. No warmup or retries.

outputs.label_index_exact: For original coarse core origin o and decoder index j=16..47: floor(5*(48*(o+128)+79*(2*j+1-64))/234), independently peraxis.
outputs.label_interpretation: Centre-point categorical comparison at31.6um; the model was trained with area-downsampled labels, so this does not replicate its area-averaged training target.
outputs.labels: Read original categorical PNG/NPY via the pinned donor manifest and cached label hash. Category0 staysunknown;1background;2ink. Use only cell-centre category, no interpolation, majority threshold or existing9.6um label raster.
outputs.operating_point: Each donor/order uses its own descriptive known-background threshold after prediction. k=floor(.05*Nbg); threshold=background sorted descending[k]; select score>threshold. Ties cannot exceed5%; not a transferred threshold or inferential FPR guarantee.
outputs.panels: One complete32x32 core per donor: categorical labels plus source/reverse scores, every probability panel fixed0..1, no min/max normalization; plots and all raw arrays outsideGit.
outputs.support: Every model input cell is inside the complete retained fine tensor. Score all original known centre categories. Do not discard known labels through an intensity/nonzero-column veto. Stored zeros remain values; zero-column counts are diagnostic.
outputs.undefined: Retain all four outputs. AP/AUC undefined if either class absent; recall-at-background-point undefined without both classes. No replacement field or new orientation.

purpose: A fixed four-forward architecture-transfer probe on two public model-assisted controls; no training, orientation selection, promotion rule, unread acquisition, or letter-reading claim

sampling.cell_edges: Source fine cell coordinates have cell i occupying[i,i+1]. For source lengthN and target lengthM, edge numerators are24*(N//2)+79*(j-M//2),j=0..M, denominator24.
sampling.depth_order: Source means increasing retained fine-array depth; reverse means exact reversal of all18 already-resampled planes. Both retained; no oracle selection.
sampling.integration: Exact separable integer voxel-cell overlap sums, each axis weights sum79. Divide the three-axis result by79^3 and round nearest even to uint8 once; no extrapolation or missing fill.
sampling.source_recipe_difference: Author standard65-plane stack selects global24:42, an upper-centred even-depth crop. This experiment instead uses a physically symmetric142.2um slab about the centre of the retained fine context, itself from the prior fixed source-centre31.5 recipe. No donor-specific offset tuning; not exact native-acquisition/author-crop replication.

selection: The centre of each previously fixed retained fine context, selected without inspecting native-resolution model outputs. No replacement if a class is absent.
status: Prepared before any probe downloads or model forwards; root must publish the exact package freeze before run
